title: Compact Mode not found

status.label: Setting location identified
status.detail: The current Command Palette settings UI contains the compact-mode toggle under Appearance; the report does not establish a missing implementation.

summary: The reporter using PowerToys 0.100.2 could not find Compact Mode while looking in Command Palette parameters. Current source exposes the feature as the Appearance setting named "Open with a compact search box."
next_action: Post the setting-location guidance; no code change is currently justified.

judgment.rationale: Focused source review confirms that Compact Mode is an existing Command Palette setting, so the supplied report is most consistent with a settings-location or terminology misunderstanding rather than a missing feature.
evidence: The report identifies PowerToys 0.100.2 and says only that the expected toggle could not be found; it provides no failure after locating or changing the setting.
src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Settings/AppearancePage.xaml defines Settings_GeneralPage_CompactMode_SettingsCard and binds its ToggleSwitch to ViewModel.CompactMode.
src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Strings/en-us/Resources.resw labels that control "Open with a compact search box."
Related open issues such as #49859 discuss Compact Mode behavior, confirming the feature is present rather than absent.
judgment.recommended_action: Explain that Compact Mode is configured in Command Palette Settings > Appearance, not as a separate PowerToys Settings entry.

fix_assessment.rationale: The available evidence identifies an existing UI control and no code defect or competing implementation needing a fix.

issue_context.summary: The report asks where to find Compact Mode in PowerToys 0.100.2, without describing a runtime malfunction or a failed toggle.
known_information: The report names Command Palette as the affected area and PowerToys 0.100.2 as the version.
The reporter expected a Compact Mode toggle under Command Palette parameters.
Current Command Palette source exposes a CompactMode property through SettingsViewModel and an Appearance-page ToggleSwitch.
inferences: The reporter may be looking in the PowerToys Settings app instead of Command Palette's own Appearance settings, or may not recognize the localized label.
issue_context.analysis: The current setting's implementation and English resource label directly match the requested behavior. A precise location response is therefore more useful and safer than proposing a code change.
initial_investigation: Reviewed src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Settings/AppearancePage.xaml, where the Compact Mode settings expander is in the layout section.
Reviewed src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/SettingsViewModel.cs, which persists the CompactMode setting.
Searched related public work and found active Compact Mode behavior reports, not a report that the feature was removed.

actions.label: Explain the Compact Mode setting location

comment.body: Thanks for the report. Compact Mode is configured in Command Palette's own settings: open Command Palette settings, select **Appearance**, then enable **Open with a compact search box** in the Layout section. It is not a separate entry on the main PowerToys Settings page. If that control is absent after opening the Appearance page, please share a screenshot of that page and the exact PowerToys version shown in Settings.

verify: Open Command Palette settings and confirm the Appearance page displays the "Open with a compact search box" toggle.
